description: Publish a local .html, .htm, .md, .markdown, .mdx or .txt file as a new page on fmrl.site and answer its link. The file is read here, so its content never passes through the model; for content already in the conversation use fmrl_publish, and to change a page you published use fmrl_edit. Only call it when the person asked to share the file. Private by default, encrypted here first: 2 MiB at most public, roughly 1.4 MB private, since encryption adds about a third. Pass visibility: "public" only when the person asked for a public page. Public content or a title carrying a recognizable credential (a private key, or an AWS, GitHub, Slack, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Stripe, GitLab, npm, Hugging Face or fmrl key) is refused. A page lasts seven days unless someone keeps it from the page itself.

path.description: Absolute path to the file (a leading ~ is expanded).

private.description: Older form of visibility: true is private, false is public. Prefer visibility.

title.description: Page title; the file's first heading is used when left out. For a private page the server stores no title; when the content is rendered from Markdown the encrypted document's own title uses it (falling back to the first heading), and raw HTML is sealed as-is.

visibility.description: private (the default): encrypted here before upload; the link carries the key after #p=, the page has no title or preview on fmrl.site, and opens only with that key. public: anyone with the link can read it, and it shows a title and preview. Either can be kept from the page itself. Pass public only when the person asked for a public page, after showing them what will be shared.

name: fmrl_publish_file
title: Publish a file to fmrl.site
